headline: School project on budget at $418 million, Skanska reports; gas leaks at two spots shut off and tested.
summary: Presenters said the project is on budget, with $364 million invoiced to date and $7.9 million of construction contingency left. Gas service to two locations was shut off after leaks were seen this week, and a second check is set for Saturday. Phase 4 work runs to spring or early summer of next year, and the fire sprinkler system no longer needs a fire pump. The December meeting was canceled, and the next meeting is January 14th.
decisions: Approved canceling the December meeting by roll call; the motion passed.
discussion: Construction budget: Members asked whether costs were on budget and whether any unforeseen costs remained. Presenters said costs were on budget and that no known unforeseen issues remained.
Gas leak repairs: Members asked for an update on leaks at two locations. Presenters said the two connections were tightened and passed tests, and that nothing beyond the valve was found leaking.

Fire sprinkler redesign: Members questioned how a pipe size change could raise pressure without a pump. Presenters said the redesign moved equipment and added a feed from Kirk Street, and a written summary was due next week.

Warranty and drainage items: Members asked about drainage in the dry sprinkler pipes, cracked concrete out front, and a list of warranty items. Presenters agreed to check pipe pitch with the contractor and to provide commissioning reports and a list of warranty items for the next meeting.
Canal refilling: Members asked when the canal would be recharged. Boott Hydro was given the green light to fill it, and the city does not own the canal.

decision_evidence.quote: So, I'd like to make a a motion to uh cancel the next December meeting. ... Yes. Motion passes.
